fieldValues.title: A spec fixture landed before the implementation's runner could read it, and srs-rust master went red
fieldValues.summary: srs-rust#1481 added a test that runs srs master's conformance/arrangement/scenarios.json. srs#981 then merged nine scenarios using shapes the runner does not know (members-move, members-add, expectedSectionOrder, expectedValidateUnchanged, a retired-key refusal code). srs-rust master CI went red at 17:52 UTC on 2026-10-28, and every srs-rust PR's Test check failed with it, srs-rust#1487 included.
evidence: srs-rust CI run 40739834351 (master push, 17:52 UTC): 9 of 30 arrangement scenarios failed
srs-rust#1487 Test failed at 18:10 for the same 9
srs#980 adds two more shapes (composition create, expectedDiagnosticContains)
fieldValues.body:
- The PR guard asked for runner first, fixture second; srs#981 merged the fixture first.
- The cost spreads: one spec PR stops every implementation PR until the runner catches up.
- Fix in hand: one srs-rust PR teaching the runner every shape, before srs#980 (another session, 2026-10-28).
